summary: The PDF supports every people count in the form: Experiment 1 recruited and randomly assigned 460 Prolific participants and Experiment 2 640 (Figures 2 and 7), no count by arm or of people analyzed is printed anywhere, so the nulls are right, and no idea count stands in for people. Criterion 2 holds on either study alone, because the Experiment 2 ANCOVA error df of 1256 implies at least 630 people analyzed and Experiment 1 reports no exclusion from 460, and the one open point (the paper does not say whether anyone took both experiments) does not affect it.
